spec_case: issue #528's own comment: a calendar-invalid timestamp in a reflector's generated plan
description: The reflector's scripted plan holds an unquoted, calendar-invalid date (`when: 2024-02-30`). The plan executes through the same inline `use` path an ordinary inline child does, so PyYAML's bare ValueError reports its message alone, with no location and no "Inline orchestration validation failed:" wrapper. expect: failure, error_compare: exact.
